<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$closure = function (string $value) {
    return $value;
};
$staticClosure = static function () {};
$arrow = fn (int $value) => $value;
$nullable = static fn () => null;
$captured = 'value';
$capturing = function () use ($captured) {
    return $captured;
};
$intersection = fn (Countable&Iterator $value) => $value;
$dnf = fn ((Countable&Iterator)|null $value) => $value;
$nested = fn () => function () {
    return 1;
};
$reference = function &(string &$value) {
    return $value;
};
$attributed = #[Deprecated] static fn () => 'value';
$compact = fn()=>1;
$multiline = function ()
{
    return 'value';
};
$commented = fn () /* before */ /* within */ /* after */ => 1;
$lineComment = fn () // Keep this comment.
 => 1;
$hashComment = function () # Keep this comment too.
 {
    return 1;
};
$compoundComment = fn () /* collection */ => null;
$untyped = fn (string $value) => $value;

function namedFunction(): string
{
    return 'value';
}

final class TypedMethods
{
    public function typedMethod(): string
    {
        return 'value';
    }
}
